Pin-to-top engineering vs zh-Hans listing copy — two different jobs

Teams assume pin-to-top capability covers storefront language. Xcode, entitlements, and Connect actually separate in-app pinned-note features from product-page copy:

  • Notes.framework, CloudKit & note persistence — in-app code that saves, syncs, and renders notes. Controls whether Pin Note actions work. Does not generate Chinese listing text. AppLocale does not implement this.
  • Pinned-note sort order & note-list UI — logic that keeps pinned rows at the top of a folder or All Notes view. Separate from the zh-Hans description paragraph that explains pin-to-top value to China buyers browsing the App Store.
  • Folder hierarchy & tag indexing — organization features in your app. Listing copy should match what screenshots actually show — a Pinned Notes section at the top, not a generic notebook tree unless that is what the frame shows.
  • Pricing and Availability → China — makes the app downloadable on the China App Store. Separate from language rows.
  • App Store tab → Chinese (Simplified) localization — independent row for title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text, screenshots, and caption lines. Empty or English here means China buyers see English fallback regardless of pin features in the binary.

Working Pin Note flows in the binary and a localized China listing are both required when you sell on the China storefront — neither replaces the other. AppLocale covers how you describe Pinned Notes and pin-to-top workflows on the product page in zh-Hans, not how you implement Notes.framework or pinned-note sort logic.

Why machine-translated Pinned Notes copy fails

  • Literal "Pin Note" → awkward 别针笔记 instead of commerce-idiomatic 置顶笔记 or 置顶此笔记
  • Generic "Pinned Notes" → 固定的笔记 (wrong) instead of 置顶笔记 (pin-to-top term buyers recognize)
  • English badge headlines preserved on zh-Hans screenshots — "Pinned Notes" with no Chinese benefit line beside it
  • Overlay text overflow — long English pin captions pasted into short screenshot callout zones truncate on device
  • Conflating 置顶笔记 with 锁定笔记 — buyers searching for pin-to-top may not match locked-note privacy keywords
  • Leading with 快速备忘录 or corner-swipe terms when the screenshot shows a Pinned Notes section — Quick Note vocabulary for a pin-to-top workflow
  • Inconsistent vocabulary between listing description, promotional text, and screenshot captions when all three mention Pinned Notes

Machine translation is fine for internal drafts. Finished pin strings need idiomatic zh-Hans that states what pin-to-top workflows you ship — while keeping accurate scope. AppLocale rewrites by hand; we do not deliver raw Google Translate or LLM output as finished copy.
